center_count.denominator: all distinct authored SceneCard (episode_no,scene_no) for the work
center_count.numerator: per character, distinct authored_cast (episode_no,scene_no) whose presence_mode is ONSCREEN, VOICE_ONLY, PHONE_OR_REMOTE, or ARCHIVAL_OR_MEMORY

opposition_persistence.HIGH: For the exact unordered pair of the two highest season_scene_share centers, authored_relarc has >=1 row in >=75% of episodes and first relation_state differs from last relation_state

conflict_persist.SEASON_LONG: FullSeriesArc season_structure begins by max(2,ceil(episodes_total*0.25)) and its final movement ends at episodes_total

ending_direction.procedure: Use validation/phase02_indicator_evidence/<work>.indicator_evidence.json. Verify all listed file hashes and support phrases. Apply the registered decision rule.

cost_realized.procedure: Use the same terminal evidence audit. A work-specific cost label is accepted only when FullSeriesArc terminal evidence and at least one final CharacterArc or PayoffCandidate support it.

compatibility.mode_independence: BLIND and FULL_READ compatible sets and alternatives are independently authored.

interpretation_limit: Accuracy resolution is 0.20. A leakage estimate of -0.20 means one indicator changed, not a precise effect size. SEED-D remains PENDING_AUTHORIZED_COHORT.
